reason: Fast Landing single-root diagnostic authorization for the remaining KF-P0-01 backend startup race. Fresh-main source inspection proves BackendProcessHost._startUnlocked dispatches child fork before BackendOwnerRegistry durable owner registration. The existing proper-lockfile-backed owner claim can reject a later contender and the start-failure path terminates that losing child, but it does not prevent two independent DesktopHost entrypoints from physically forking backend children before claim arbitration. KF-P0-03's existing proper-lockfile owner-record claim is PRESERVE evidence and is not silently reclassified by this package. Initial implementation is tests-only and must prove the pre-fork admission defect on exact head. Production remains forbidden until fresh causal RED, complete same-root closure matrix and unknownBlockers=0.
